facts.title: ethereally smooth hummus
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups cooked, drained chickpeas (from a 15-ounce can) or a little shy of 2/3 cup dried chickpeas (for same yield)
1/2 teaspoon baking soda (for dried chickpeas only)
2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice, or more to taste
3/4 teaspoon table salt, or more to taste
Approximately 1/4 cup water or reserved chickpea cooking water
facts.author: Deb Perelman
